slices.name: AnnounceEta + CancelEta endpoints + events
slices.description: New files in src/AreYouAt/Features/Presence/: AnnounceEta.cs (POST /places/{place}/eta, body {magicword, nickname, minutes}, validate minutes in {5,15,30,45}, append Presence/EtaAnnounced event), CancelEta.cs (POST /places/{place}/eta/cancel, body {magicword, nickname}, append Presence/EtaCancelled). Register both in AreYouAtModule.cs MapEndpoints.

slices.name: SetStatus endpoint + event
slices.description: New file src/AreYouAt/Features/Presence/SetStatus.cs (POST /places/{place}/status, body {magicword, nickname, status}, trim and slice status to 30 chars, append Presence/StatusSet event). Empty string is a valid clear. Register in AreYouAtModule.cs.

slices.name: Projection: fold ETA + Status into PresenceToday
slices.description: Extend PresenceProjection.cs: add EtaEntry(Nickname, Minutes, AnnouncedAt, Status?) record. Add Status field to PresenceEntry. Add Etas List to PresenceToday. Fold rules: Presence/EtaAnnounced adds to etas dict (keyed by nickname, latest wins); Presence/EtaCancelled removes from etas; Presence/Announced for a nickname implicitly cancels its active eta; Presence/StatusSet updates status for that nickname (both presence and eta views). Ignore non-today events (match existing date filter).

slices.name: Deploy backend + curl-verify endpoints
slices.description: Commit + push backend slices 0-2 (GitHub Actions auto-deploys to Azure). Once deployed, curl the new endpoints against prod labsapi-hmeva5cfhdfkejhz.westeurope-01.azurewebsites.net to verify: announce eta, cancel eta, set status, then GET /today and confirm etas array and status field appear correctly in response.

slices.name: Ship staged UI fixes (field swap + titles)
slices.description: Commit + push the already-staged changes in slices/friend/landing/landing.js (place field first with slash prefix, magicword second) and slices/friend/i18n/i18n.js (landing_heading_a/b restored to 'är du på?' / 'are you in?'). Standalone warmup commit, independent of other work.

slices.name: API wrappers + i18n keys
slices.description: Add to lib/api.js: setEta(place, pp, nickname, minutes), cancelEta(place, pp, nickname), setStatus(place, pp, nickname, status). Add i18n keys in both sv and en per design bundle: onTheWay, etaPrompt, etaHint, setEta, arrived, cancelEta, status, statusPlaceholder, showMore (with {n} interp), showLess. No UI changes yet — just the plumbing.

slices.name: Status slice: render + tap-to-edit on self pill
slices.description: New slice slices/friend/status/ with status.js + slice.css. Added to index.html and 404.html. Exposes PRESENCE.renderStatus(entry, isSelf) returning HTML, and PRESENCE.mountStatusEditor() wiring the tap-to-edit flow (swap to inline input maxlength=30, autofocus, commit on Enter/blur via AREYOUAT.setStatus, revert on Escape). get-today.js calls into these but holds no status logic itself. Italic Instrument Serif with curly quotes, ellipsis truncate.

slices.name: History cap + expand toggle
slices.description: In slices/friend/presence/get-today.js: cap rendered history at 3 entries by default. Below the visible set, add mono 10px uppercase toggle button. Collapsed label: showMore with hidden count. Expanded label: showLess. Client-only state (module-scoped var is fine). CSS for .history-toggle in slice.css.

slices.name: ETA slice: on-the-way band + chooser + self pill
slices.description: New slice slices/friend/eta/ with eta.js + slice.css. Added to index.html and 404.html. Exposes PRESENCE.renderOnTheWayBand(etas), PRESENCE.renderEtaChooser(), PRESENCE.mountEtaHandlers(), PRESENCE.selfHasEta(etas). In get-today.js renderPopulated: render on-the-way band (centered label with horizontal rules, then eta pills — self first with dashed ink border, [i'm here] ink button that calls announcePresence then refreshes, × cancel that calls cancelEta; others dashed soft border 0.85 opacity) above presence pills. Inject ETA chooser CTA below presence pills (only when self has no active presence and no active eta). Collapsed: dashed box with italic prompt + 'SET ETA' mono label. Expanded: 4 equal-flex chips labeled 5m/15m/30m/45m calling setEta then refresh.
